facts.claim: The Lion Monument commemorates Swiss Guards who died in the 1792 storming of the Tuileries in Paris.
facts.sourceLocation: Paris in turmoil: created in honour of the Swiss Guards who died in the Storming of the Tuileries in Paris in 1792.

facts.claim: The sculpture was designed by Bertel Thorvaldsen and inaugurated in 1821, in a rocky grotto within a park setting.
facts.sourceLocation: Opening description; The man behind the vision.
